outcome: Iron levels in colostrum and mature breast milk
Zinc levels in colostrum and mature breast milk
Vitamin A levels in colostrum and mature breast milk
cohort: 34 mothers of low birth weight infants (17 preterm and 17 term) at Dr. Soetomo hospital
finding: Zinc levels were significantly higher in colostrum compared to mature milk for both preterm and term infants, while vitamin A levels were only significantly higher in colostrum of mothers with preterm infants; iron levels did not change significantly during the lactation period.
